crossRefs.note: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you…
who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous…
Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

For you are our glory and our joy.
For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you…
